GOOGL: max score across all three components, $5.5M flow + $1.08B dark pool
NVDA: flow 8.96 driven by $37M call premium + $2.6B dark pool — largest absolute conviction on the board
AAPL: $18M call flow + $1.5B dark pool print, score 9.47

GS: 9.37 flow + $373M dark pool — banks being bid

narrative.rotation_signal: Institutions are accumulating mega-cap tech (AMZN, GOOGL, NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, META-adjacent names), financials (GS, V, AXP), and defensives (WMT, KO, ABBV, XOM) simultaneously — a broad risk-on print. The distribution is surgical: semiconductor capital equipment (LRCX, KLAC, MU, TXN) and heavy industrials/defense (CAT, RTX, IBM, GEV, CVX) are being sold into strength, with large dark pool prints on weak flow signaling institutional exit rather than accumulation.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: Semis are split at the Top 50 level: NVDA is a max-conviction buy while LRCX/KLAC/MU/TXN show flow near zero — any broader 'semiconductor bullish' industry read would mask this equipment-vs-design divergence. CVX bearish also diverges from XOM's perfect 10 within energy.
